name: notion-paste
title: Notion Field Paste
description: Search Notion databases and paste field values into any app
author: pavelapekhtin

commands.name: notion-databases
commands.title: Notion Field Paste
commands.description: Pick a database, then search and paste a field value

preferences.name: databasesJson
preferences.title: Databases JSON
preferences.description: JSON array of database configs. Each entry needs: label, databaseId, searchProperty, searchPropertyType, displayProperties, pickerProperties, and optional filterProperty/filterPropertyType/filterValues.

preferences.name: notionApiKey
preferences.title: Notion API Key
preferences.description: Your Notion integration token. Create one at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and share it with your target databases.
